name: Cerac, Inc.
old_description: As the world's leading manufacturer of engineered, specialty strip metal solutions and copper-beryllium rod and wire products, we offer the widest range of reel-to-reel and screw machinable materials for a variety of high-performance connectors for 5G and big data applications.
about:
Cerac, Inc. is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The company traces its origins to 1921, when it began unlocking the potential of beryllium for advanced industrial applications. Over nearly a century, it has grown into a global advanced materials enterprise.

The company manufactures specialty engineered alloy systems, inorganic chemicals and powders, precious and non-precious metals, beryllium and beryllium composites, and precision filters and optical coatings. Its core product lines include engineered strip metal solutions and copper-beryllium rod and wire, produced via reel-to-reel and screw-machinable processes. Operations span more than 30 locations worldwide with a workforce exceeding 3,000 employees.

Cerac serves customers in semiconductor, industrial, aerospace and defense, energy, automotive, telecommunications and data center, and consumer electronics markets. Its materials enable high-performance connectors for 5G and big data infrastructure, thermal management for rocket engines, and nuclear-grade beryllium for clean energy projects.

The company states its purpose is to push the boundaries of innovation to enable breakthrough solutions that move the world forward. It differentiates itself through the widest range of reel-to-reel and screw-machinable copper-beryllium products, integrated analysis, testing, engineering, and recycling services, and a legacy of nearly 100 years in beryllium and advanced materials expertise.
